title: Grateful Dead Live at Frost Amphitheatre on 1982-10-09
source: Soundboard->Cassette Master(MA-R90/Dolby B)->1st Generation Cassette(XLII-S90/Dolby C).1st Generation Cassette->Fostex D5 (pass-through only)->ZA2->Samplitude v7.02 Professional->.wav->mkw->SHN. Transfer, editing, and SHN by Joe Samaritano

ai_review.summary: High‑energy 10/9/82 Frost Amphitheatre show with smoking On the Road Again > Beat It on Down the Line, Estimated > Eyes and a legendary Morning Dew, captured on a generally clean soundboard despite wind hiss and a missing Bob guitar.
ai_review.review: The concert is remembered as an exuberant California fall day, highlighted by tight transitions like On the Road Again into Beat It on Down the Line, a soaring Estimated‑Eyes pairing, and one of the all‑time best performances of The Morning Dew.  The soundboard source is mostly clear and well balanced, though listeners note a slightly windy ambience, occasional loudness, and an absent Bob Weir rhythm track that requires EQ adjustment.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high 4‑5 star reviews praise the show’s energy, standout songs and band interaction; recording is described as clean soundboard with minor issues, yielding an overall strong rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clean SBD with limited cassette hiss; some wind noise and a slightly loud mix; Bob Weir's rhythm guitar is notably missing from the mix.

standout_songs: On the Road Again > Beat It on Down the Line
show_quality.setlist_flow: First set flows smoothly with tight transitions; second set features unusual pairings (e.g., Touch > T Stones) and strong outro jams, keeping momentum high throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia delivers emotional, powerful leads; his tone is praised throughout.
band_member_comments.Phil: Phil's bass wind‑up into GSET energizes the crowd; reviewers note he was smiling a lot.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bob Weir’s rhythm guitar is missing from the recording mix, though live accounts mention his on‑stage flirting and presence.
band_member_comments.Drums: Drums are described as fine and well captured.
